item.title: Atrium raises staff starting rate minimum wage
item.description: Atrium Health Navicent is making a significant additional investment into its local workforce, announcing an increase in the minimum starting rate wage for eligible teammates in Georgia to $18.85 per hour, which will be reflected on the teammates’ Jan. 30 paychecks.

item.title: Bunn’s Bulldogs on quest for state repeat, national bid
item.description: Ashley Bunn and the Georgia Military College softball Bulldogs returned to the top of the Georgia Collegiate Athletic Conference in 2025, celebrating their first tournament championship since 2022.

item.title: Commissioners honor gift wrapping volunteers
item.description: Those who attended the meeting were presented certificates for their compassion and empathy for children who otherwise might not have enjoyed as bright a Christmas.

item.title: Family home, vehicles damaged by gunfire
item.description: A man, his wife and their two grown sons are fortunate they were not injured Saturday morning after their home and vehicles were damaged by bullets in Baldwin County, local authorities say.

item.title: Stasney named Main Street director
item.description: Jennifer Graham Stasney has been named the director of Milledgeville Main Street.

item.title: Tax board, chief appraiser discuss moving forward
item.description: Baldwin County Board of Tax Assessors chairman Harry Keim says there’s a communication problem between the tax commissioner and the tax assessors offices.

item.title: BROWN: My friend Carrie
item.description: It was a common occurrence on any random afternoon for me to drop by my sister/friend Carrie Cox’s house for a snack: a Diet Coke and chips or cheese and crackers, with the intention of watching an interesting television show. For months, we watched “The Crown,” but sadly, we never completed the series.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Make time for matters of the heart
item.description: We can all help save a life.

item.title: Grand jury indicts 5 men for aggravated assault, other crimes
item.description: Five men were recently indicted by a Baldwin County grand jury on counts of aggravated assault and other crimes stemming from a joint case that happened last year.

item.title: Chamber Young Entrepreneurs finalists to compete Thursday
item.description: The Milledgeville-Baldwin County Chamber of Commerce has announced the top finalists of the 2025-26 Young Entrepreneurs Program (YEP).
